entregar-issue/scripts/prepare_actions_h: The official workflow entrypoint is responsible for the authenticated PR issue and exact-JUnit provenance, canonical source snapshot and certified handoff phase. Splitting those linked phases without a shared controller risks duplicating evidence state. It is below the fixed hard limit, cannot publish and has focused adversarial phase-specific tests.
entregar-issue/scripts/produce_actions_h: The single evidence producer checks immutable issue keys, exact-SHA JUnit attestation and report digests before staging results for certification; it never approves or publishes a handoff. Draft reviews remain pending and adversarial tests cover absent and forged inputs. Source remains below the fixed hard limit.
entregar-issue/scripts/publish_actions_h: The privileged publisher is the exclusive trusted default-branch-only atomic transaction: validate artifact provenance, all material workflow checks, exact head and result-only allowlist before a fast-forward update and terminal revalidation. Splitting it would risk expanding the write trust boundary. It does not execute untrusted PR code with write permissions and remains below the hard cap.
